name: i.safe MOBILE IS930.2
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS930.2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) 8-inch Android tablet from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 14.

otherSchemes: EAC, KCs, INMETRO, IA South Africa

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc IP64 / II 3D Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc IP64
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0 (2020-01-31), checked 2026-10-25. ATEX per DoC 1041CC06REV00. Zone 2 ATEX (category 3) does not need a notified body type examination.

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T4 Gc IP64 / Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc IP64

certification.northAmerica: NEC 500: Class I Div 2 Groups A, B, C, D T4; Class II Div 2 Groups F, G T135°C; Class III Div 2 (CSA 20CA70220244)

safety.conditions: IECEx X conditions: battery may be charged outside explosion hazardous areas only; protect against permanent UV light and high electrostatic charge processes; ambient −20 °C to +60 °C. Safety instructions: only zones 2 or 22; all interface covers closed in Ex areas; charge only outside Ex areas at +5 to +35 °C; battery not interchangeable.
safety.peripherals: Opening interface or connector covers in an Ex area is not permitted; physical connections to other equipment only outside Ex areas.
safety.certifiedAccessories: As IS-930.1: IS-DS930.1 dock, IS-MC930.1 multi charger, PROTECTOR cables, leather case and straps, vehicle mount (all charging/cable items outside Ex areas).

specs.display: 8-inch Glove-usable touch display; Corning Gorilla Glass V3 stated on the IS930.M1 page (not on the IS930.1 page)
specs.ports: USB-C; 24-pin docking interface; magnetic charger port; earphone jack; microSD slot; micro-SIM
specs.docking: Office dock IS-DS930.1 (RJ45, 3 x USB); IS-MC930.1 six-bay multi charger; vehicle mount
specs.gnss: GPS, A-GPS, Glonass, Beidou (Galileo added on IS930.M1 page)
specs.keys: SOS key (red); two freely programmable keys
specs.touch: Usable with gloves (maker); wet-touch not stated

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Via app (PTT/PoC app on a programmable key; no PTT button accessory listed for IS930)

capabilities.label: Lone worker
capabilities.value: Via app (LWP ready: third-party application required, per maker page)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Via app (camera-based; no dedicated scan engine listed)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (front and rear cameras, Wi-Fi/LTE; third-party app)
